tools.name: get_booking

tools.name: cancel_booking

tools.name: my_bookings

tools.name: my_profile
tools.description: Read the signed-in user's own profile (name, email, phone, language, where Awning writes to them), or update it: pass only what should change, or nothing to just read. Use it to learn what contact details booking can reuse. It is about the person, not about a business: for a business's details use o

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Signs the user out of Awning in this assistant only: the next personal request asks them to sign in again. With everywhere=true, signs out of every assistant, device and browser. Use it only when the user asks to sign out; it changes no bookings.

tools.name: owner_import_source

Each answer says what is missing and what next (instructions_for_assistant); keep draft_id. Not for a live business: use owner_update_business, owner_add_offering

tools.name: owner_photos

tools.name: owner_remove_photos

tools.name: owner_pause

tools.name: owner_update_business

tools.name: owner_update_offering

Confirm with the owner first; archiving cannot be undone. Use it to change a service that exists; to add a new one use owner_add_offering. Send only what changes.

tools.name: op_businesses

tools.name: op_suspend_business
tools.description: Only for the Awning team. Hide a business from clients, e.g. on complaints or an ownership dispute. It leaves the catalogue and search at once. Use it only on the operator's explicit instruction; to return a business to review use op_decide_application with recall.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: my_profile, owner_import_source, owner_photos, op_decide_application, op_suspend_business · Private data: get_business, create_booking, my_profile, owner_photos, owner_remove_photos, owner_list_bookings, owner_update_business, op_applications, op_businesses · Public sink: create_booking, my_profile, owner_import_source, owner_photos, owner_submit, owner_set_schedule, owner_update_offering, owner_upsert_sessions, op_leads, op_decide_lead, op_analytics · Destructive: owner_remove_photos, owner_block_time, op_analytics.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: my_profile, owner_import_source, owner_photos, op_decide_application, op_suspend_business · Private data: get_business, create_booking, my_profile, owner_photos, owner_remove_photos, owner_list_bookings, owner_update_business, op_applications, op_businesses · Public sink: create_booking, my_profile, owner_import_source, owner_photos, owner_submit, owner_set_schedule, owner_update_offering, owner_upsert_sessions, op_leads, op_decide_lead, op_analytics · Destructive: owner_remove_photos, owner_block_time, op_analytics

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
